facts.fact: StackAdapt was named a Platinum winner in the Marketing Video, Service category at the 2026 Hermes Creative Awards for its 'Every Impression Builds Momentum' video series.
facts.quote: has been named a Platinum winner in the Marketing Video, Service category at the 2026 Hermes Creative Awards

facts.fact: The same 'Every Impression Builds Momentum' video series earned both Gold and Platinum honors at the Viddy Awards, according to StackAdapt.
facts.quote: The same video series also earned both Gold and Platinum honors at the

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its 2026 Hermes Platinum marks the second time in three years the company has received this honor.
facts.quote: this achievement marks the second time in three years that the company has received this honor

facts.fact: According to the Hermes Creative Awards organizer, winners were selected from over 200 categories grouped under advertising, publications, marketing/branding, integrated marketing, public relations/communications, electronic media, and pro bono.
facts.quote: Winners were selected from over 200 categories grouped under advertising, publications, marketing/branding, integrated marketing, public relations/communications, electronic media, and pro bono.

facts.fact: The Association of Marketing and Communication Professionals (AMCP), which administers and judges the Hermes Creative Awards, consists of several thousand professionals, per the release.
facts.quote: The international organization consists of several thousand marketing, communication, advertising, public relations, media production, and freelance professionals.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes the Hermes Creative Awards as one of the oldest and largest creative competitions in the world.
facts.quote: The Hermes Creative Awards is one of the oldest and largest creative competitions in the world

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its unified platform covers programmatic and owned channels including CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, and email.
facts.quote: unifies programmatic and owned channels—including CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, email, and more—into one seamless experience
